landing.headline: Understand your money. Plan your goals. Build better habits.
landing.subhead: Moneyflow keeps your numbers, tracks real spending against your plan, simulates what-if scenarios with real math, and checks in with you every month.
landing.startGuest: Start from scratch as a guest
landing.demoNote: The demo opens a private sample account with four months of realistic data. No sign-up needed.

health.title: A health score you can read
health.body: A score out of 100 from four transparent rules: savings rate, emergency fund, debt load and fixed costs.

plan.title: A plan that adapts
plan.body: 50/30/20, zero-based or custom budgets, goal timelines, and avalanche vs snowball debt plans.

simulator.title: What-if, with real math
simulator.body: Save more, cut a category, change income: charts update instantly from tested code.

daily.title: Five-second entry
daily.body: Quick entry, recurring items, CSV import with duplicate detection, and a subscription tracker.

coach.title: An AI coach that explains
coach.body: The AI never does the math. It explains the numbers the code computed and checks in monthly.

private.title: Your data, your control
private.body: No bank connections. Export everything as CSV, or delete your account and all data in one click.
